parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for tylophorine (CHEMBL493620) and its salt forms against target CHEMBL3879801. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from the parent compound CHEMBL493620 to include all related forms. Retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter for target CHEMBL3879801 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows.
